claims.claim: Perfectly refurbished standing Gas cooker in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show a 4-burner gas cooker with an oven door and knobs, but no clear evidence of ignition/flame quality, leak testing, or oven heating performance.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No readable brand/model label, date, or receipt/warranty details are shown in the provided report.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: The report does not show internal components or any proof that the unit has never been opened; photos only show the exterior.
Receipt/warranty card are not shown or described as readable in the report.

risks.risk: Gas compatibility/connection type is unclear (LPG vs natural gas), since regulator/hose details are not clearly shown.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the regulator/hose connection and any label indicating LPG/NG compatibility (or a short clip showing the correct regulator attached).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gas cooker with unknown compatibility/connection readiness.

risks.risk: Burner ignition and flame quality may not work correctly (or may be weak/uneven), and leaks cannot be confirmed from the photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip of lighting all 4 burners (including low flame) and a leak test demonstration (e.g., soapy water bubbles at joints) or a professional test receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working/needs testing.

risks.risk: Oven functionality is unknown (heating performance, thermostat/control operation, oven ignition/light).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the oven turning on, temperature/thermostat setting changes, and visible heating/oven light/ignition (if present).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (dents, rust, missing parts, cracks on the glass door) may exist but are not clearly verifiable from the current angles.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the oven glass close-up, door edges, burner grates, and the full body from multiple angles (including underside/hinges).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case cosmetic/parts condition for a used unit.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or spares (tray, racks, extra burner caps) could reduce value.
risks.proof: A photo inventory showing included tray/rack(s) and any spare burner caps/parts laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming accessories may be incomplete.

risks.risk: Brand/model and exact specifications are not readable, making it harder to match to market value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the brand/model rating plate (usually on the side/back) with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unverified generic 4-burner gas cooker.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model rating plate (readable).
Clear photo of the gas regulator/hose connection and any LPG/NG compatibility label.
Video: light all 4 burners (including low flame) and show stable flame.
Video or demonstration of oven heating (thermostat/controls) and oven ignition/light (if present).
Close-up photos of oven glass door (front and edges) plus full body for dents/rust/cracks.
Photo inventory of included accessories (tray, racks, burner caps/spares).
Photo of receipt and warranty card (readable).
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a 4-burner standing gas cooker with an oven and front controls, so it can be priced at worst-case used condition; however, working status, compatibility, and oven performance are not verifiable from the report, so the price should reflect that uncertainty.
